name: 3508-replace
about: je-replace (no code) replaces the game's particle DeathSmokeS00 (of the effect DeathSmokeS), a Goomba's death smoke, in red: the cook says it replaced the game's particle (cook.effect, replaced 1) and refuses nothing; the stage plays with the game's own table starting it (a stomped Goomba's red smoke: a person's look)
